## TendPrivate22
**Purpose:** Error workflow for private workflows 10-20.

**Inputs:** n8n Error Trigger (production runs only; publish 22 after import).

**Outputs:** POST /api/live/failure-log on the private API.

**Privacy:** Keeps workflow and node names, plus a literal guard message or HTTP status; any other error text is withheld. Private lane: no execution data is saved (success and error), so provider text never lands in n8n history.
